A master warning indicator light that illuminates or blinks in conjunction with the warning mode display of the multi-information display is provided in the combination meter.

ITEM.PTXT: Taking advantage of the dot matrix characteristic of having no restrictions on display patterns, the multi-information display switches between and displays a wide variety of information according to various situations.
Displays the name of the malfunctioning system when a malfunction signal is input from each system.
Displays the diagnostic trouble code when a request to display a diagnostic trouble code occurs due to a malfunction in certain systems.
Pressing the DISP switch switches between display of current fuel consumption / cumulative average fuel consumption / driving range / cumulative average vehicle speed / cumulative driving time.
Hours and minutes can be adjusted.
Year, month and day can be adjusted.

If a warning mode, etc. interrupts the display while cruise information is displayed, the display can be switched between that mode and cruise information mode by pressing the DISP (display item selection) switch.

ITEM.PTXT: Signals from each vehicle system are input to the meter computer in the combination meter; based on these signals, the meter computer calculates each value displayed in cruise information mode, displays information via the multi-information display, and controls illumination and blinking of the master warning indicator light. In addition, the signal from the DISP (display item selection) switch is input to switch between each display item and display mode.
